messages.identity.help:
Client cryptographic identity (Ed25519)

  identity generate [--yes]          Generates the key pair, only if none exists yet. Asks for confirmation.
  identity show [--json]             Status, Device ID, fingerprint and full public key.
  identity export [--output FILE]    Exports the public identity only (format baradwatchu.public-identity.v1);
                                     with --output writes a new file (never overwritten).
  identity reset [--yes]             Full reset: new key pair, removal of ALL trusted Servers, cancellation of
                                     pending consent requests. Confirmed by typing RESET.

Why: the keys allow a BaradWatchU Server to request an audit of this machine. Every request must still be
accepted by the user through a notification: being trusted never starts an audit by itself.
The public key can be shared; the private key stays on this device only, in a file accessible to this user only,
and is never shown, copied or exported. Exchange the public key in person or through secure channels and check
the fingerprint over an independent channel. Keys are never generated automatically (installation, start-up,
audits and updates never create them) and are never regenerated when files are damaged.
If you suspect the private key is compromised, run `identity reset` and exchange the new public key again.
--yes confirms without an interactive terminal (scripts). Exit: 0 done, 1 cancelled by the user, 2 error.
messages.trust.help:
BaradWatchU Server trust store

  trust list [--json]                       Lists Servers (trusted and revoked).
  trust import FILE [--fingerprint FP]      Imports a Server public key from a local file.
                                            Shows name and fingerprint and asks for confirmation; without a
                                            terminal, --fingerprint with the verified value is required.
  trust show SERVER-ID [--json]             Details of one Server.
  trust revoke SERVER-ID [--yes]            Revokes a Server: the revocation stays recorded and the key cannot
                                            be imported again until you clear the trust store.
  trust clear [--yes]                       Remove all trusted Servers (recorded revocations included).
                                            The Client identity stays unchanged: this is not a reset.

Trust never comes from the network: the file arrives via USB, CD, PGP-signed message or another secure channel,
and the fingerprint must be compared with the one given by the Server's administrator over an independent channel.
The Client never accepts keys offered by a remote device. A trusted Server may only present audit requests:
every remote audit still requires the user's acceptance through a notification.
Exit: 0 done, 1 cancelled by the user, 2 error.

messages.server.requirement.REQ-006.macosDescript: Checks that FileVault is on for the startup volume.

REQ-001.name: Software updates
REQ-001.description: Checks whether updates are available for installed packages.
REQ-001.windows_description: Checks through Windows Update that no software update is pending.

REQ-002.name: Antivirus protection
REQ-002.description: Checks that a supported antivirus (providers: ClamAV, Microsoft Defender, Bitdefender GravityZone, Windows Security Center) is active with up-to-date signatures. With an empty acceptedProviders one compliant provider is enough; listed providers become mandatory.
REQ-002.windows_description: Checks that a supported antivirus (providers: Microsoft Defender, Bitdefender GravityZone, Windows Security Center) is active with up-to-date signatures. With an empty acceptedProviders one compliant provider is enough; listed providers become mandatory.

REQ-003.name: Firewall protection
REQ-003.description: Checks that UFW, firewalld, or nftables provides active filtering evidence.
REQ-003.windows_description: Checks that Windows Defender Firewall (or a firewall registered in Security Center) blocks inbound traffic on every profile.

REQ-004.name: DNS filtering
REQ-004.description: Checks that dnsmasq filters DNS or that /etc/hosts contains a complete, current HaGeZi list.
REQ-004.windows_description: Checks that the hosts file contains a complete, current HaGeZi list.

REQ-005.name: Corporate VPN
REQ-005.description: Checks the connection state of supported Cato and WireGuard VPN clients.
REQ-005.windows_description: Checks that the Cato VPN client is present and whether it is connected.

REQ-006.name: Data encryption
REQ-006.description: Detects supported encryption methods: LUKS and eCryptfs.
REQ-006.windows_description: Checks that BitLocker protects the system drive and the other fixed drives.

REQ-008.name: Password security
REQ-008.description: Checks expiry, length, and minimum character variety for local account passwords.
REQ-008.windows_description: Checks expiry, warning, length, and complexity required for local account passwords.

REQ-009.name: Boot security
REQ-009.description: Checks platform protections that contribute to secure boot.
REQ-009.windows_description: Checks UEFI boot with Secure Boot on and the presence of a TPM 2.0.

cli_help:
BaradWatchU Client {version}

Usage:
  baradwatchu-agent refresh
  baradwatchu-agent list [--json]
  baradwatchu-agent enable ID | disable ID
  baradwatchu-agent priority ID HIGHEST|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|OPTIONAL
  baradwatchu-agent configure ID JSON_OBJECT
  baradwatchu-agent check ID [--log]
  baradwatchu-agent audit [--json] [--notify] [--log]
  baradwatchu-agent status [--json]
  baradwatchu-agent history [--json]
  baradwatchu-agent history delete STAMP | history clear --yes
  baradwatchu-agent report-theme list | report-theme use ID
  baradwatchu-agent identity generate|show|export|reset …   (identity --help)
  baradwatchu-agent trust list|import|show|revoke|clear …   (trust --help)
  baradwatchu-agent remote enable|disable|status [--json]   (remote audit requests)
  baradwatchu-agent service run   (system service)
  baradwatchu-agent custom accept ID | custom remove ID
  baradwatchu-agent dashboard [--no-browser] [--open ROUTE]
  baradwatchu-agent notifications [--json]
  baradwatchu-agent events --json [--after ID]
  baradwatchu-agent consent simulate|list|accept|reject …
  baradwatchu-agent --version

Custom checks live in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/baradwatchu/custom-checks/CUSTOM-*/ (configuration.json + tool). `custom accept` pins the tool SHA-256 after an intentional edit. Reports are stored locally in audit history; `history delete` removes one audit and its report, log and PDF, while `history clear --yes` removes all of them. Audits do not require the dashboard or Server. REQ-001 may contact Arch mirrors via checkupdates. Tools run as the current user. The optional tray provides desktop notifications and the consent window; requests are local simulations, and only an explicit acceptance authorizes one request.
The cryptographic identity (identity) and the Server trust store (trust) are optional and local: keys are generated only on explicit request and Servers are imported only from files verified out of band.
